units.normalized_text: Morning all. We need to pick the weekend for the billing cutover to the new platform. Let's settle it in this thread.
I'd propose Nov 14-15. UAT should be done by then and it's well before the holidays.
Another option is Nov 21-22. One more week of buffer.
And Dec 5-6 is possible if we slip. Probably not, but listing it.
Good. Let's go through constraints first. Marcus, anything from Finance?
Month-end close takes the last three business days of the month. For this window that means keep clear of Nov 25-30.
Nov 14-15, Nov 21-22 and Dec 5-6 all avoid that.
Support constraint: our holiday staffing freeze starts Nov 23. After that I can't add weekend cover.
So Dec 5-6 doesn't work for me. I'd rather not do it then.
Understood, withdrawing Dec 5-6.
From my side I need five full days after UAT sign-off for the final data sync and rehearsal.
UAT sign-off is scheduled for Friday Nov 6. I can hold that date.
Nov 6 plus five days is Nov 11, so Nov 14-15 works for me.
Nov 21-22 works too but I'd rather not stretch it.
Dev, how long did the last cutover take?
The last one was about 9 hours on a Saturday night. This one is bigger so I'd plan for 12.
OK. Criteria then: risk, support coverage and finance close. Anything else?
Customer notice. We promised customers 5 days notice for billing changes.
That's easy for either date.
For me Nov 14-15 is cleaner. Close is well behind us and I can brief the auditors the week before.
Nov 14-15 works for support. I'll have full weekend cover.
Nov 14-15 is good for QA.
Nov 14-15 from me as well, it was my first pick.
Nov 14-15, yes. I'd make Nov 21-22 the backup if UAT slips, not the main plan.
Agreed on that. Anyone against Nov 14-15?
No objection.
None here.
None.
None.
None, go.
Then it's decided: cutover Sat Nov 14 to Sun Nov 15. Backup is Nov 21-22 if UAT sign-off slips past Nov 6.
Next steps. Dev, can you write the runbook and have it reviewed by Nov 9?
Yes, runbook by Nov 9.
I'll sign off UAT on Nov 6.
I'll send the customer notice by Nov 9.
I'll lock the weekend support rota by Nov 2.
I'll brief the auditors on Nov 10 and confirm back here.
Great. I'll book the war room and post the final schedule once the runbook is done.
Thanks everyone.
